column1: # Sweeps --floor in {10,30,50,70,90} riding the current compiled defaults
# (slope=500, min_weight=10, oldestsource=1). With slope=0.5 each transfer is
# 0.5*(source_weight - floor): the floor is the source weight at which the
# transfer is exactly 0 (below it w<0 and the source is skipped). Lower floor =
# sources drain further down + larger transfers; higher floor = gentler, sources
# stop donating sooner. fl90 is the current default (baseline anchor).
